questions.question: Through Jeremiah, the LORD said a man can hide in a secret place where God cannot see him. True or false?
The LORD said the lying prophets hoped their dreams would make His people forget His name. True or false?
The LORD spoke against prophets who claimed certain words came from Him. Where did these prophets get the words?

answers.text: They stole them from one another
They copied them from old scrolls
They bought them from the priests

questions.question: Through Jeremiah, what did the LORD say He would do to people who kept claiming "the burden of the LORD"?

answers.text: Forget them and cast them out
